=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/scripts/usage_limit_resumes.py:348-358 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The runtime `is_limit_wait` accepts mixed limit-error or wait-prefix text without checking every word against `LIMIT_WAIT_VOCABULARY`, so actionable requests can be misclassified as limit waits.
  WHY: The pickup executes this root copy, allowing sessions with an unanswered human action to be resumed; reviewers consistently rated this BLOCKER.
- .claude/scripts/usage_limit_resumes.py:468-481 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The runtime `_skip_reason` returns `too_old` before checking for an unanswered request.
  WHY: An old session awaiting human input can be classified for manual resume past the pending decision; reviewers disagreed on severity, rating it MAJOR or BLOCKER, so the higher rating is used.
- tests/test_usage_limit_resumes.py:952-953 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: `test_template_parity` fails because the runtime script and template twin have diverged.
  WHY: The parity assertion compares the two copies byte-for-byte, but the review-round fixes were applied only to the template copy.
- docs/plans/issue-6102-skip-unanswered-question-resumes-plan.md:56 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The plan's Approach step describes the superseded prefix and substring classifier rather than the `LIMIT_WAIT_VOCABULARY` allow-list.
  WHY: A future reader following the plan could use a permissive rule that contradicts the implemented classifier.
- docs/plans/issue-6102-skip-unanswered-question-resumes-plan.md:46-105 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The plan says the handbook's manual fallback covers unknown wording, although the handbook says not to manually resume a session with an unanswered request.
  WHY: This stale guidance can lead an operator to resume a session past an unresolved decision; reviewers disagreed on severity, rating it NIT or MAJOR, so the higher rating is used.
- docs/plans/issue-6102-skip-unanswered-question-resumes-plan.md:48 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The plan's §6 identifier list omits `LIMIT_WAIT_TOKEN_PATTERN` and `LIMIT_WAIT_VOCABULARY`.
  WHY: The documented list of audited new module-level identifiers is incomplete.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
